firstPlayerRule: Pick a starting player and give them the starting player card. The rulebook does not say how to pick.
clarifications: The starting player is the first active player; turns then go clockwise.
The starting player keeps the starting player card all game: a tie for most gold goes to the tied player sitting furthest clockwise from the starting player.
